emma_sec: quick heads-up: a SAST critical on main blocked a deploy but Cloud Audit Logs show no KMS Decrypt entry for the deploy-sa around that timeframe. can someone check? :thinking:
prashant_eng: saw it. GH Actions shows decrypt failed then retried and succeeded ~20s later. excerpt: 

2026-03-20T14:02:11Z ERROR decrypt: permission denied
2026-03-20T14:02:31Z INFO retrying decrypt
2026-03-20T14:02:33Z INFO decrypt ok

mike_sre: likely ephemeral grant timing. what's TTL for the keystore-service grants? if TTL < propagation time audit may not show creation before first attempt.
prashant_eng: current TTL is 45s. we set it low to reduce blast radius.
lisa_prodsec: two asks: (1) premerge gating should verify a Decrypt audit log exists for any SAST-critical blocking run, (2) security needs a readable audit trail — grant audit-reader the minimal KMS view role and bump logging retention to 90d.
emma_sec: proposal: GH Action post-deploy that runs gcloud logging read 'protoPayload.methodName="google.crypto.kms.v1.KeyManagementService.Decrypt" AND protoPayload.authenticationInfo.principalEmail="deploy-sa@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com"' --limit=1 --project=redwood-prod --format=json. if empty, mark PR as needs-security-approval. also recommend increasing grant TTL to 5m and add retry+backoff on decrypt.
prashant_eng: agree. add a 30s buffer before querying to reduce false positives and set GH status "kms-audit" pending -> success/failure instead of hard failing to avoid noisy author pain.
mike_sre: I'll add a small structured trace emitted right before decrypt so we can correlate trace_id -> audit entry. also will help metrics for missing-audit-rate.
cicd-bot: [auto] created ticket SEC-621: "premerge KMS-audit check for SAST-critical blocking runs" assigned @emma_sec. link: https://github.internal/redwood/security/tickets/SEC-621
emma_sec: I'll file infra request for role change + retention, open GH Actions PR with log-check + TTL bump, and update the runbook for sec oncall steps when missing decrypt logs. ping me if you want to help implement the action. :+1:
